extra_sections.title: Response fields observed on live data (2026-11-18)
extra_sections.body:
| Resource | Shape |
|---|---|
| `GET /v4/user/{user-id}/hosts/` | `{hosts: [{host_id, ascii_host_url, unicode_host_url, verified, main_mirror}]}` — **no `count` field**; `main_mirror` is an object for a secondary mirror and `null` for the main host |
| `GET .../summary/` | `{sqi, searchable_pages_count, excluded_pages_count, site_problems}` — `sqi` is an integer and `0` is valid |
| `GET .../diagnostics/` | `{problems: {<CODE>: {severity, state, last_state_update}}}`; `severity` is `FATAL`, `CRITICAL`, `POSSIBLE_PROBLEM` or `RECOMMENDATION`; `state` is `PRESENT`, `ABSENT`, `NOT_APPLICABLE` or `UNDEFINED` |
| `GET .../indexing/history/` | `{indicators: {HTTP_2XX: [{date, value}], HTTP_3XX: [...], HTTP_4XX: [...]}}` — crawl-event timestamps, `{}` when the window has no events |
| `GET .../sqi-history/` | `{points: [{date, value}]}` — daily; can be empty |
| `GET .../search-queries/popular/` | `{count, queries: [{query_id, query_text, indicators: {<QUERY_INDICATOR>: number}}], date_from, date_to}` |
| `GET .../sitemaps/` | `{sitemaps: [{sitemap_id, sitemap_url, last_access_date, errors_count, urls_count, children_count, sources, sitemap_type}]}` — includes sitemaps found via `robots.txt` |
| `GET .../user-added-sitemaps/` | `{sitemaps: [...], count}` — only sitemaps added by the user; the list can be empty while `/sitemaps/` is not |
| `GET .../important-urls/` | `{urls: [{url, update_date, change_indicators, indexing_status, search_status}]}` |
| `GET .../recrawl/quota/` | `{daily_quota, quota_remainder}` |

Observed diagnostic codes include `NO_REGIONS`, `NOT_IN_SPRAV`, `NO_METRIKA_COUNTER_CRAWL_ENABLED` (all `PRESENT` on `https:antimanager.pro:443`), `NO_METRIKA_COUNTER_BINDING` and `DOCUMENTS_MISSING_DESCRIPTION` (`PRESENT` on `https:exhomebird.ru:443`). Treat unknown codes as forward-compatible: read `severity` and `state`, do not whitelist codes.

extra_sections.title: Query statistics parameters
extra_sections.body:
- `order_by` (required) and `query_indicator` (required) select the ranking indicator.
- `date_from` and `date_to` are `YYYY-MM-DD`; omitted means the last week.
- `limit` and `offset` page the result; `count` is the number of rows returned, not the total.
- `search-queries/all/history/` returns the same indicators per date without `order_by`.
